$comment: The line for testdata/youtube/sTF-6_xinUU.mp4 — a public traffic camera at a
signalised intersection, at night. 1280x720, 91 s.
WHY THIS LINE IS VERTICAL, which is the part that looks wrong until you look
at the frame: the carriageway runs LEFT TO RIGHT across the picture, so the
far lane the vehicles use is a horizontal band at y about 0.54, and a line
ACROSS that carriageway is vertical. A horizontal line here would never be
crossed by anything, and a run with no events is indistinguishable from a run
where the model found nothing — which is the most expensive silence there is.
WHERE IT CAME FROM, stated plainly so a reader does not have to guess:
the frame was LOOKED at, and then the model's own detections on that frame
were measured with pyworker, one sample per second across the clip. At t=51
through t=55 the vehicles sit at y 0.51-0.58 and score 0.75-0.93, which is a
detector working, not one being tuned. The line spans y 0.44 to 0.64 so it
covers that band with margin on both sides.
Two vehicles cross x=0.65 per pass of that four-second window, which is what
the demo needs: an event is a crossing, and a zone with no crossing is a demo
with no event to show.
The clip itself is NOT in git — testdata/youtube*/ is gitignored — and its
licence is NOT recorded. See testdata/labels.json. This file is in git because
it is the measurement, and it is useless without the footage; the reverse is
also true.
AND, since 2026-10-11, this geometry is reachable only by naming the clip:
`pocctl demo` used to default to testdata\youtube\sTF-6_xinUU.mp4, which
handed every operator material their own provenance table says may not be
shown to anyone. There is no default now, and `demo --clip` plus this sibling
zone file is the only way this line is used. See testdata/README.md.
`motion` is in `classes` and it is not a typo. It is the class the shipped
novelty trigger emits for a region it measured with pure-Go arithmetic, and a
zone declares WHICH CLASSES MAY CROSS IT. The file listed only car/truck/bus/
person, which is the COCO vocabulary, and every one of the 291 regions this
clip produces was refused with no event and no error. Measured on 2026-10-01:
peak changed fraction 0.209, 291 regions, and not one of them was allowed to
cross a line because none of them was a class the line had heard of.
